title: Witch's Cosmic Portal
description: A horned witch in a red coat and brown jacket stands holding a glowing orb in one hand while casting a spell with the other. Behind her is a jagged blue portal revealing three ghostly armored warriors, with a green cat familiar sitting on an ornate platform to her right and flowering branches dripping red liquid on the left.
prompt: A horned female witch with pale skin wearing a red dress and brown jacket stands before a jagged blue cosmic portal. She holds a glowing orb in her left hand and casts a spell with her right. Three ghostly armored warriors are visible inside the portal. A green patterned cat familiar sits on a stone platform to the right. Flowering white branches with dripping red liquid frame the left side. Paint drips from the top of the image. Dark background with mystical atmosphere.
